what: A cloud image drifts straight left in place by 2 times its width, fades out at 50%, jumps to a position 3 times its width to the right at 51% and reappears, then drifts back to its place (linear, endless). Giving each cloud a different length of 30 · 40 · 50s makes the sky flow in layers — used for the hero sky and the footer sky

options.--fx-dur: Length of one loop, default 40s (the original’s five clouds run 30·40·40·50·30s)
options.--fx-delay: Start delay, default 0s — give a negative value to start midway
options.--fx-out: Distance to flow left (ratio of its own width), default 200%
options.--fx-in: Right-hand position to reappear at, default 300%

from.where: index.html hero five clouds (original .bgKvArea .cloud01~05 — animationKvCloud 30·40·40·50·30s linear infinite)

note: The parent must be overflow: hidden so no horizontal overflow occurs when jumping to the 3× spot on the right
